::: {#exr-training-flops}

#### The cost of training

Training a [language model](language-models.qmd#def-language-model) with $N$ [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter) on $D$ tokens takes about $6 N D$ floating-point operations,
or FLOPs [@hoffmann2022training, section 3.3].
@hoffmann2022training trained Chinchilla,
a model with 70 billion parameters,
on 1.4 trillion tokens.
How many FLOPs did that take?

:::
